plugin.note: Magic axes have low defences (slash and magic +5); a slash weapon works well. Reaching them needs 23 Thieving and a lockpick to open the hut door. Bring only cheap Wilderness-appropriate gear.

requirements: Kills must be made in the Wilderness to count for the Krystilia assignment.
23 Thieving and a lockpick are needed to open the Axe Hut door.
No Slayer level or quest requirement.
mechanics: Magic axes (npc 2844) are combat level 42 with 44 Hitpoints and grant 44 Slayer XP.
They attack with slash melee at a 4-tick speed.
Defence level 29 with slash (+5) and magic (+5) their lowest defences; crush (+15) is highest.

methods.label: Slash melee
methods.summary: Kill the 9 Axe Hut spawns with a slash weapon against their low slash defence (+5).
steps: Open the Axe Hut door with 23 Thieving and a lockpick.
Kill the magic axes with a slash weapon.
notes: Bring only cheap gear; this is a Wilderness spot with PKer risk.

methods.label: Ranged
methods.summary: Range the axes against their low magic (+5) and moderate ranged (+10) defences.
steps: Open the Axe Hut door with 23 Thieving and a lockpick.
Attack the magic axes with ranged.
notes: Slash melee is still faster against their +5 slash defence.

styleOptions.label: Slash melee
styleOptions.summary: Slash exploits their lowest melee defence (+5).
